name: B10-0038/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the ‘Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice’
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns the Taliban's new "morality law", which further restricts how women look, behave and move, and it asks the Taliban to cancel it. It calls for girls to be allowed to go to school, for detained activists to be freed, and for the European Union to give more aid and protection to Afghans, especially women, girls and minorities.

- The Taliban are urged to scrap the morality law and let girls go to school.
- The European Union is asked to fund Afghan rights groups and protect activists.
- European countries are asked not to deport Afghans and to give them residence permits.
